name: wg_width
description: WG ridge width at the BASE (as drawn in GDS)

name: wg_radius
description: Minimum bend radius of the WG cross-section

name: ridge_height
description: Ridge height above the slab

name: slab_thickness
description: Remaining LN slab thickness

name: sidewall_angle
description: Ridge sidewall angle measured from the slab surface

name: s_bend_length
description: Length of the sine S-bends along x

name: dc_port_separation
description: Centre-to-centre arm separation at the coupler ports

name: dc_gap
description: Directional coupler gap at the ridge base (50:50 design)

name: dc_length
description: Directional coupler straight coupled length (50:50 design)

name: taper_width_wide
description: Wide end of the grating-coupler taper (= grating width)

name: taper_length
description: Grating-coupler taper length (PLACEHOLDER until the EME sweep is done)

name: gc_period
description: Grating coupler period (3D FDTD: 0.384 peak eff at 1558 nm; 1550 nm eff 0.370)

name: gc_fill
description: Grating tooth BASE width divided by period

name: gc_n_periods
description: Number of grating periods

name: gc_fiber_angle
description: Fibre tilt in air; positive = tilted toward the waveguide side in the 3D FDTD convention

name: bend_radius
description: Radius of the circular bends (U-turns
column6: MZI arms); chosen from the 3D FDTD bend study (R = 20

name: gc_pitch
description: Fibre-array pitch used for the output grating couplers on the test die

name: mmi_width
description: 1x2 MMI multimode section width at the ridge BASE (3D FDTD tolerance check: 4.9/5.0/5.1)

name: mmi_length
description: 1x2 MMI multimode section length (3D FDTD length sweep: 16.5/17.5/18.0 -> 0.29/0.15/0.19 dB)

name: mmi_taper_width
description: Width of the access tapers at the MMI (ridge BASE)

name: mmi_taper_length
description: Length of the 1.0 um -> mmi_taper_width access tapers

name: mmi_port_offset
description: Distance of each output centre from the MMI axis (= mmi_width / 4 for the symmetric 1x2 interference)

name: mmi_port_separation
description: Centre-to-centre separation of the two MMI output ports after the S-bends (as simulated)

name: mmi_lead_length
description: Straight lead between each MMI port plane and the taper or S-bend (as simulated)
